483-1263-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-1263-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Cruel Celebrant and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-8174.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Mabel.
When Mabel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mabel enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1349-6495-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-6495-6854.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 6.
Repeat.
1349-6495-6854.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-4050-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4050-5789.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

1456-4067-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1011-2728-2921-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-2921-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-2921-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1619-4605-5542-6146-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6146-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6146-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

104-1818-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1818-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

821-2173-5220-6772.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-6258--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-5319-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2511-5319-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

3605-3967-4812-5987.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3525-4773-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Overgrown Arch does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Overgrown Arch.
2060-3525-4773-6996.description:
Activate Overgrown Arch by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Overgrown Arch.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-7110-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent
1618-2440-7110-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Stormchaser's Talent triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-7110-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

372-695-6927.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-695-6927.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Damage Control Crew and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Damage Control Crew trigger.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Damage Control Crew and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2781-5917-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
2781-5917-6753.description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Felidar Guardian that are 1/1 Balloons with haste.
When the Felidar Guardian tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent and The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3499-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3490-4050-5870-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-5870-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Guide of Souls indestructible.
3490-4050-5870-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1647-3371-5149-5385.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Galvanic Alchemist is paired with Codie.
Power Artifact attached to any artifact.
Any additional nonpermanent card in hand with mana to cast it.
1647-3371-5149-5385.description:
Cast Aura Finesse by paying {U}, attaching Power Artifact to Codie and drawing a card.
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Codie using the ability from Galvanic Alchemist by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining trigger.
1647-3371-5149-5385.notes: Step 1 is necessary because you cannot cast Power Artifact once Codie is on the battlefield.

1742-2131-5660.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature or artifact card in your graveyard.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
1742-2131-5660.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning an artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Thran Vigil triggers. Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding an artifact or creature card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Thran Vigil ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Repeat from step 2.

874-1482-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
874-1482-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

803-2292-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
803-2292-5853.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
803-2292-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Snail, causing you to scry 1.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

2792-3489-3960.notablePrerequisites:
Walker of Secret Ways does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
2792-3489-3960.description:
Declare Walker of Secret Ways as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Walker of Secret Ways from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Walker of Secret Ways's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Walker of Secret Ways onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2097-3340-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2097-3340-3542.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, creating twelve Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate eleven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {7}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may sacrifice them to Jolene's ability.

1634-3319-3858.notablePrerequisites: There is an enchantment with mana value five or greater on the battlefield.
1634-3319-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, cast Aura Mutation by paying {G}{W}, destroying target enchantment with mana value five or greater, and creating at least five 1/1 Warrior creature tokens.
When the Warriors enter the battlefield, Devilish Valet triggers that many times, doubling its power that many times, causing its power to be at least 32 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

396-1778-4050-5222.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Realms attached to Memnite.
396-1778-4050-5222.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {1}.
When Memnite dies, Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Memnite to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Unicorn, adding {W}.
Activate Sword of the Realms' equip ability by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Memnite.
Repeat.

351-1149-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Dagger and Shadowspear attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
351-1149-3957.description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

575-2034-2860.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Proteus Machine, adding {C}{C}.
Proteus Machine dies, triggering Yedora, returning Proteus Machine to the battlefield face down as a Forest land with no other types or abilities.
Activate Proteus Machine by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Proteus Machine's morph ability by paying {0}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1651-1737-2419-3698.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treasure Vault.
The Treasure Vault token enters, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasure Vault token and Grinding Station, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1283-1409-4617.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Soulbright Flamekin.
1283-1409-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin 3 times paying {2} each time, adding eight {R} with the third activation.
Pay {2} to activate the ability granted to Soulbright Flamekin by Deadeye Navigator, blinking it.
When it ETBs, pair it with Deadeye Navigator.
